referenceSchema.title: Captured observation metadata
referenceSchema.description: One source-neutral snapshot shared by reference and actual Storybook capture. Publication identity is supplied by the CLI binding manifest.

elements.description: Selected subjects with their observed state and view coverage.

prelude_digest.description: SHA-256 of the prelude module that prepared every pass of this revision. Absent when the capture used no prelude. Fixing it here means a later prelude edit cannot silently redefine what was observed.

kind.description: Opaque source kind declared by its integration skill.

identity.description: Stable source identity supplied by the skill; may be a URL or file identity.

ReferenceFolder.description: Path to a scene's verification material — contains one source dump per declared state (`extract--<state>.json`), `meta.yml`, and one screenshot per view/element/state cell, named `<view>--<element>--<state>.png`. The leading segment is the view id the metadata declares; a view carries a breakpoint only where that mapping is established, and the file name stays on the view.

SourceDump.title: Stored source extract
SourceDump.description: One browser dump for one state of a capture revision (`extract--<state>.json`): one page load, in one session, at that state. Agents consume it through `reference save` stdout, `reference inspect` and `reference query`, never by opening the file. Walker-specific extra keys on the dump object are allowed.

source_ref.description: Observed source identity, typically the URL.

nodes.description: Observed nodes with native locators, boxes and styles. Extra walker keys are allowed.

items.description: One captured node. Keys include id, kind, locator, box and style.

CaptureFile.title: Captured binary artifact
CaptureFile.description: Declared direct screenshot or asset file; plan done records its exact file integrity.

ElementId.description: Stable label for the comparison subject, used in filenames and scores. Name the rendered surface, not the capture area: entity stories use `entity-<entity_type>-<bundle>-<view_mode>` (for example `entity-paragraph-signage-full`, where `full` is the view mode), scene regions use names such as `scene-header` or `scene-footer`, and components use `component-<name>`. Use `selector: ""` to capture the isolated story root; do not encode that capture mode as `id: full`. A trailing `full` in an entity id is valid when it is the entity view mode.

kind.description: Integration-defined locator kind such as css or figma-node.

value.description: Exact native identity; a Figma node is not a CSS selector.

BreakpointId.description: Viewport breakpoint identifier from `design-tokens.yml` (sm, md, lg, xl, ...). Determines the viewport width for capture/verify operations.

id.description: Stable selected viewport or frame identity.

breakpoint.description: Explicit responsive mapping when established during intake.

states.description: Explicit observed states; source-specific replay details belong in the source workflow. Each state has its own dump `extract--<name>.json`, so a state name identifies one page load in one session across the whole revision and cannot carry different observers on different subjects.

session.description: Who observed this state. `anonymous` is the reserved name for a capture taken without a stored session; any other name must be a key of `sessions:` in designbook.config.yml, which resolves it to a Playwright storage state. Required so a published revision states its observer instead of defaulting to anonymous in silence.

views.description: Selected views; no implicit frame-to-breakpoint mapping.
